entries.title: Psalms 134:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Servant - Peculiarly so called, priests and Levites. Night - Not only by day, but also by night, when their watch was more necessary. Stand - Serve or minister.

entries.title: Psalms 134:3–135:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Thee - Thee whosoever thou art who dost faithfully perform the duty here commanded.
